parts.label: 01 Timber rough opening
parts.note: Generic rough opening, not an engineered lintel or a scheduled house window.

parts.label: 02 Wall wrap around opening
parts.note: Generic drainage layer. Opening integration and membrane selection follow the selected wall/window system.

parts.note: Conceptual outward drainage and upstand. End dams, laps and dimensions require a system-specific detail.

parts.label: 04 Jamb flashing
parts.note: Show jamb flashing overlapping sill flashing. Final folds, laps and fixing-fin arrangement are product-specific.

parts.label: 05 Window and glazing

parts.label: 06 Glazing
parts.note: Illustrative relationship; product and installation detail to be confirmed.

parts.label: 07 Head flashing
parts.note: Conceptual head flashing beneath the upper wrap, projecting outwards. Extension, fall and end treatment require confirmation.

parts.label: 08 Brick veneer cutaway
parts.note: 110 mm brick leaf and 40 mm nominal cavity are model assumptions. Partial skin exposes the opening layers.

parts.label: 09 Internal lining cutaway
parts.note: 10 mm plasterboard is noted on architectural sheet 12. Seals and reveal finish remain schematic.

parts.label: 02 Wall wrap
parts.note: Illustrative relationship; product and installation detail to be confirmed.

parts.label: 03 Upper foam/render cutaway
parts.note: 100 mm foam with rendered finish follows architectural notes. Approved system, top termination and fixings remain unselected.

parts.label: 04 Roof battens
parts.note: Batten sections and spacings here are illustrative, not a fixing schedule.

parts.label: 05 Roof sarking
parts.note: Secondary drainage layer shown toward the eaves. Final support, laps, ventilation and gutter termination require the chosen roof-system detail.

parts.label: 06 Metal roof cutaway

parts.label: 07 Fascia

parts.note: Conceptual collection channel only. Capacity, fall, outlets, overflow provision and downpipes are not designed.

parts.label: 09 Soffit cutaway

parts.label: 01 Upper and lower wall frame
parts.note: Detached floor-edge sample. The house floor datum remains unchanged.

parts.label: 02 Floor-edge structural zone
parts.note: 413 mm supplier zone is used ONLY in this sample. Architecture shows 400 mm. Chris must resolve the conflict before fitting the house deck.

parts.label: 03 Floor sheeting cutaway
parts.note: 19 mm panel thickness from supplier layout page 47. Sample size and edge support are illustrative.

parts.label: 04 Wall wrap across transition
parts.note: Continuity is a design question at this transition. Final laps, air barrier and drainage path need coordinated wall-system details.

parts.label: 05 Lower brick veneer cutaway
parts.note: 110 mm brick leaf / 40 mm cavity split is assumed. Masonry support and movement allowances are not resolved.

parts.label: 06 Transition flashing concept
parts.note: A conceptual outward-draining flashing beneath the upper system. Do not use these folds or dimensions for installation.

parts.label: 07 Upper foam/render cutaway
parts.note: 100 mm foam noted in the architecture. A compatible termination, movement joint, drainage and fixing system remain to be selected.

parts.label: 08 Ceiling and wall lining
